title: A Winter for the House
author: Rafael Sterling
blurb: Felix Thackeray, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
